description: A single-panel spin-polarised density-of-states (DOS) plot from a first-principles calculation on FeAl, identified by the panel label "a FeAl" in the upper-left corner. The x-axis is "Energy / eV" spanning −10 to 20; the y-axis is "DOS / (States·eV⁻¹·atom⁻¹)" spanning −2 to +2. Spin-up curves are drawn above the zero line (Up-states, black solid; Up-Al-s, dark-blue dashed; Up-Al-p, green dash-dot; Up-Fe-d, orange dotted) and spin-down curves below it (Down-states, red solid; Down-Al-s, purple dashed; Down-Al-p, dark-blue dash-dot; Down-Fe-d, blue dashed). An unlabelled vertical dashed line marks 0 eV. The spin-up total DOS shows a very sharp peak immediately above 0 eV that runs off the top of the axis past the +2 gridline, and the spin-down total DOS shows a comparably sharp peak immediately below 0 eV that approaches the −2 gridline; the orange Up-Fe-d partial curve rises from about −4 eV and peaks near the +1 gridline near +1 eV. Both Al-s and Al-p partial DOS stay close to zero over the whole range, so the DOS is dominated by Fe-d states. Beyond ~2 eV both total curves oscillate weakly out to 20 eV, and below about −5 eV all curves are essentially zero. The pronounced spin-up/spin-down asymmetry demonstrates a spin-polarised (magnetic) FeAl ground state.

observations.observation: The figure is a single spin-resolved DOS plot labelled "a FeAl", with x-axis "Energy / eV" from −10 to 20 and y-axis "DOS / (States·eV⁻¹·atom⁻¹)" from −2 to +2.

The legend contains exactly eight entries: Up-states, Up-Al-s, Up-Al-p, Up-Fe-d, Down-states, Down-Al-s, Down-Al-p, Down-Fe-d; spin-up curves are drawn above the zero line and spin-down curves below it.
An unlabelled vertical dashed line is drawn at 0 eV on the energy axis.
The spin-up total DOS (black solid) has a very sharp peak immediately above 0 eV whose apex lies above the +2 gridline and is cut by the top of the plotted frame.
The spin-down total DOS (red solid) has a similarly sharp peak immediately below 0 eV that approaches the −2 gridline.
The Up-Fe-d partial DOS (orange dotted) rises from roughly −4 eV and peaks near the +1 gridline close to +1 eV, then falls to low values above ~2 eV; the spin-down Fe-d curve does not mirror it.
The Al-s and Al-p partial DOS curves in both spin channels stay close to the zero line across −10 to 20 eV, indicating the valence DOS is dominated by Fe-d states.

Above about 2 eV both total curves oscillate weakly and persist to 20 eV, the spin-up curve oscillating roughly between the zero line and +1 and the spin-down curve oscillating between about −0.3 and −1.
Below about −5 eV all total and partial curves are essentially zero, i.e. the low-lying valence states lie between roughly −5 eV and the Fermi level.
The large asymmetry between the spin-up and spin-down total DOS near 0 eV indicates a spin-polarised, magnetic FeAl ground state.
The narrow dark dash-dot curve (labelled Down-Al-p) immediately below 0 eV dips sharply downward in a narrow spike; the exact curve assignment of this sharp dip is uncertain from the rendering.
No numeric data values (peak heights, magnetic moment, Fermi energy) are printed on the figure; only axis tick values are given, so peak magnitudes can only be read against gridlines.

Up-states and Up-Al-s / Up-Al-p / Up-Fe-d are plotted above zero, Down-states and Down-Al-s / Down-Al-p / Down-Fe-d below; an unlabelled vertical dashed line marks 0 eV. Sharp total-DOS peaks sit immediately above 0 eV (spin-up, exceeding the +2 gridline) and immediately below 0 eV (spin-down, approaching the −2 gridline); Al partial DOS are near zero throughout.
